listed_quote.quote: The Target Trust and Acquiring Trust are separate registered open-end management investment

announcement.quote: If the Reorganization of only one Target Fund is approved by its shareholders, then the Target Fund that received approval of the Reorganization will implement the Reorganization.

deals.notes: Open-end mutual fund series of Advisors Preferred Trust (CIK 1556505, subject company on the 425s) reorganized into a series of Managed Portfolio Series (the registrant, CIK 1511699). The acquiring fund is named in the excerpts only as the 'Acquiring Income Fund'; the CIK shown is the acquiring trust's. The Special Meeting set for May 17, 2022 was adjourned for lack of quorum, to May 31, 2022 and later adjourned a fourth time (425 of 2022-06-08). The outcome is not stated in the excerpts. A later N-14 (2022-08-25) covers a single Target Fund and is not identified in the excerpts.
